gloss: lover of alcohol; lover of spicy food

definitions.gloss: a person who prefers alcohol to sweets; a drinker
definitions.explanation: traditionally, someone who enjoys drinking alcohol rather than eating sweet things

definitions.gloss: a person who loves spicy food
definitions.explanation: in modern usage, someone who enjoys spicy or hot-flavored foods

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧ (spicy; sake-loving) + {党|とう} (party, group) → spicy/sake party

ORIGINAL MEANING:
Historically, ⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧ in this context meant "not sweet" rather than "spicy." The word referred to people who preferred ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧ (sake) over ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの (sweets). This is why {辛党|からとう} was the opposite of ⟦{甘党|あまとう}→甘党：08339_amatou⟧.

MODERN SHIFT:
Today, many people interpret {辛党|からとう} as "spicy food lover" due to the common meaning of ⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧ (spicy). Both usages are now accepted.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{甘党|あまとう}→甘党：08339_amatou⟧ (sweet tooth) - prefers sweets
- {辛党|からとう} (drinker/spice lover) - prefers alcohol or spicy food

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧もの{好|ず}き (lover of spicy things)
- ⟦{下戸|げこ}→下戸：19823_geko⟧ (person who can't drink alcohol)
